verdict.rationale: Porkbun documents a first-party REST/JSON API that covers registration, DNS, SSL, hosting and WordPress provisioning end to end with "no dashboard". API keys work even when account 2FA is on, so scripts can run unattended. Sandbox `pk1_sb_` keys, `/mock` endpoints, `dryRun` and `Idempotency-Key` headers suit automated pipelines that need safe testing and retries. missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guidance (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), an official headless CLI, independent or hands-on corroboration of unattended automation use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: A clean REST/JSON API to register, renew, transfer and fully manage domains
Provision hosting and deploy a static site end-to-end — no dashboard.
Porkbun API keys work regardless of whether account two-factor authentication is enabled — you never have to weaken account security to automate.
Test the whole API end-to-end in an isolated **sandbox** — a `pk1_sb_` key runs every operation against a simulated environment with fake credit
Pass dryRun: true to run every pre-flight check (availability, price match, eligibility, funds, spend limit) without charging or creating anything
a retry within 24h replays the original result instead of registering (or charging) twice.
each key can be limited to specific source IPs (CIDR supported) and/or specific domains
